review_rules.note: IGN reports 158 municipalities / 235 municipal districts; selected sources have 155 municipalities.
Portmore parish boundary realignment was under consultation on 2026-06-02; acquisition does not verify operative post-transition boundaries.
Original ISO=ANT and HASC_1=AN.* retained alongside adm0code=BES. Do not treat those historical IDs as present ISO country codes.
Old TYPE_1 classifications retained; contemporary municipal listing calls Diego Martin and Siparia Borough Corporations.
COD-AB has 140 communes/570 sections; GeoNames has 145 communes/573 sections with an intervening arrondissement tier. Completeness/currentness unverified.
Plymouth is a deserted town in the restricted exclusion zone; GeoNames PPLC is not evidence of a habitable or deliverable address.

identity_policy: Original source codes and source-qualified namespaces; never merge on names or coordinates.
address2_policy_ja: Address2という欄名だけで地理階層を推定しない。行政区分・集落と街路・番地・建物・部屋は別要素。この版は行政階層と集落参照であり、建物・部屋や未収録住所の自動生成はしない。
